description: Stop a standing want by id. Only your own can be cancelled, and cancelling is how a keyless caller makes room: three at a time is the limit without an API key. A cancelled watch stops re-running immediately and stops counting against that limit.

client_ref.description: The same opaque reference you created the watch with. Required to cancel a keyless watch; ignored when you send an API key.

watch_id.description: The watch id from demand.create_watch / demand.list_watches

name: demand.cancel_watch

cancelled.description: True when the watch was found and deactivated.

title: Cancel a standing want
